blocks.text: 🪝 NITI Aayog Releases 'Strategic Roadmap for Making Ayurveda Global' by 2047. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: 3-pillar framework targeting formal Ayurveda recognition across 20 national healthcare systems.
3-Pillar Framework: Availability, Acceptability, and Propagation (prepared with PwC).
Export Growth: Ayurvedic exports rose from .09 billion (2014) to .16 billion (2023) across 150 countries.
Key Recommendations: WHO-aligned Global Ayurveda Register, World Federation for Ayurveda & Yoga, and export Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia.
Ayurvedic exports 2023 (.16 billion) vs 2047 target (20 national healthcare systems).
